section: Indian Independence Act 1947; the Constituent Assembly - demand, composition, functioning
subsections: Other functions - flag, anthem, song, Dominion Legislature, interim government and portfolios

accepted.s: The Indian Constituent Assembly ratified India's membership of the Commonwealth in:
accepted.x: India's membership of the Commonwealth was ratified in May 1949.
accepted.tq: Use precise date-period discrimination among closely related constitutional decisions.
accepted.sec: Other functions - flag, anthem, song, Dominion Legislature, interim government and portfolios

accepted.s: The Constituent Assembly decided that Vande Mataram would be:
o: used only during sessions of the Constituent Assembly
replaced by Jana Gana Mana as the national song
honoured equally with Jana Gana Mana
included as the sole national anthem
accepted.x: Vande Mataram was to be honoured equally with Jana Gana Mana and was given equal status.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the constitutional status of two closely associated national symbols.
accepted.sec: Other functions - flag, anthem, song, Dominion Legislature, interim government and portfolios

accepted.s: The Constituent Assembly began functioning as the Dominion Legislature from:
accepted.x: From 17 November 1947, the Constituent Assembly also sat as the Dominion Legislature.
accepted.tq: Separate the dates of the Assembly's constituent and legislative functions.
accepted.sec: Other functions - flag, anthem, song, Dominion Legislature, interim government and portfolios

accepted.s: Who was the Speaker when the Constituent Assembly sat as the Dominion Legislature?
accepted.x: G.V. Mavalankar served as the Speaker of the Dominion Legislature.
accepted.tq: Match the office with the person who held it, rather than with a prominent Assembly chairman.
accepted.sec: Other functions - flag, anthem, song, Dominion Legislature, interim government and portfolios

accepted.s: The Munshi-Ayyangar formula relating to the official language was adopted on:
accepted.x: The Munshi-Ayyangar formula was adopted on 14 September 1949, a date now observed as Hindi Diwas.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between dates associated with language, national symbols and commencement of the Constitution.
accepted.sec: Other functions - flag, anthem, song, Dominion Legislature, interim government and portfolios

accepted.s: Which one of the following was NOT a feature of the Munshi-Ayyangar formula?
o: Continuation of English during the transition
Inclusion of 14 languages in the Eighth Schedule
Immediate discontinuation of English for Union purposes
accepted.x: The formula provided for a 15-year transition, continued English for Union and inter-provincial use meanwhile, and listed 14 other languages. It did not provide for immediate discontinuation of English.
accepted.tq: Identify the exception by testing the precise scope and time limit of a formula.
accepted.sec: Other functions - flag, anthem, song, Dominion Legislature, interim government and portfolios

accepted.s: Under the Munshi-Ayyangar formula, English was to continue during the transition primarily for:
accepted.x: English was to continue for Union and inter-provincial use during the 15-year transition towards Hindi.
accepted.tq: Apply the stated language arrangement to a practical administrative situation.
accepted.sec: Other functions - flag, anthem, song, Dominion Legislature, interim government and portfolios

accepted.s: The Interim Government of India formed in 1946 was proposed by the:
accepted.x: The Interim Government was proposed by the Cabinet Mission, comprising Pethick-Lawrence, Stafford Cripps and A.V. Alexander.
accepted.tq: Use the correct sponsoring body instead of a neighbouring constitutional proposal.
accepted.sec: Other functions - flag, anthem, song, Dominion Legislature, interim government and portfolios

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly gives the members of the Cabinet Mission?
o: Pethick-Lawrence, Stafford Cripps and A.V. Alexander
Stafford Cripps, Rajendra Prasad and A.V. Alexander
accepted.x: The Cabinet Mission consisted of Pethick-Lawrence, Stafford Cripps and A.V. Alexander and came to India in March 1946.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure three-member composition and reject substituted Indian or Viceroy names.
accepted.sec: Other functions - flag, anthem, song, Dominion Legislature, interim government and portfolios

accepted.s: The Interim Government was announced on 24 August 1946 and formed on 2 September 1946. Which one of the following events immediately preceded its formation?
o: The adoption of the Munshi-Ayyangar formula
Direct Action Day called by the Muslim League
The Assembly sitting as Dominion Legislature
accepted.x: The Muslim League observed Direct Action Day on 16 August 1946, shortly before the Interim Government was formed on 2 September 1946.
accepted.tq: Arrange closely spaced 1946 events by identifying the immediate preceding event.
accepted.sec: Other functions - flag, anthem, song, Dominion Legislature, interim government and portfolios

accepted.s: Direct Action Day was observed on 16 August 1946 primarily as a protest against:
o: The Viceroy inviting the Congress to form the Interim Government
The adoption of Hindi as the official language
The ratification of India's Commonwealth membership
The election of Rajendra Prasad as President
accepted.x: The Muslim League called Direct Action Day as a protest against Wavell inviting the Congress to form the Interim Government. It was followed by the Calcutta riots.
accepted.tq: Link a political action to its immediate cause rather than to a later constitutional event.
accepted.sec: Other functions - flag, anthem, song, Dominion Legislature, interim government and portfolios

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is correctly matched with a portfolio in the Interim Government?
o: Sardar Patel — Home, Information and Broadcasting
Rajendra Prasad — External Affairs and Commonwealth Relations
accepted.x: Sardar Patel held the portfolios of Home, Information and Broadcasting. Nehru held External Affairs and Commonwealth Relations, Liaquat Ali Khan held Finance, and Rajendra Prasad held Food and Agriculture.
accepted.tq: Use portfolio–person association and reject swapped neighbouring portfolios.
accepted.sec: Other functions - flag, anthem, song, Dominion Legislature, interim government and portfolios

accepted.s: Who held the portfolio of Industries and Supplies in the Interim Government?
accepted.x: John Mathai was assigned Industries and Supplies.
accepted.tq: Test a less prominent portfolio-holder rather than relying only on the principal ministers.
accepted.sec: Other functions - flag, anthem, song, Dominion Legislature, interim government and portfolios

accepted.s:
Match List-I with List-II and select the correct answer using the code given below:
List-I (Member)
a. Jagjivan Ram
a. C. Rajagopalachari
c. C.H. Bhabha
d. Asaf Ali
List-II (Portfolio)
i. Education and Arts
ii. Labour
iii. Works, Mines and Power
iv. Railways and Transport
accepted.x: Jagjivan Ram held Labour; C. Rajagopalachari held Education and Arts; C.H. Bhabha held Works, Mines and Power; and Asaf Ali held Railways and Transport.
accepted.tq: Start from a sure portfolio pair and complete the one-to-one matching.
accepted.sec: Other functions - flag, anthem, song, Dominion Legislature, interim government and portfolios

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
o: Abdur Rab Nishtar — Posts and Air
accepted.x: Jogendra Nath Mandal held Law, not Defence. Abdur Rab Nishtar, I.I. Chundrigar and Ghaznafar Ali Khan held Posts and Air, Commerce and Health respectively.
accepted.tq: Find the wrong person–portfolio pairing while the other three are exact matches.
accepted.sec: Other functions - flag, anthem, song, Dominion Legislature, interim government and portfolios

accepted.s: The committee concerned with negotiating with the States was the:
accepted.x: The States Committee dealt with negotiations with the States and was chaired by Jawaharlal Nehru.
accepted.tq: Distinguish committees with similar constitutional and provincial functions.
accepted.sec: Committees of the Assembly → chairman

accepted.s: The Order of Business Committee of the Constituent Assembly was chaired by:
accepted.x: Dr K.M. Munshi chaired the Order of Business Committee.
accepted.tq: Use the exact committee title to avoid confusing it with procedural committees chaired by Rajendra Prasad.
accepted.sec: Committees of the Assembly → chairman

accepted.s:
Which one of the following correctly identifies the chairmen of the two Union-related committees?
1. Union Powers Committee — Jawaharlal Nehru
2. Union Constitution Committee — Jawaharlal Nehru
3. Provincial Constitution Committee — Jawaharlal Nehru
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: Jawaharlal Nehru chaired both the Union Powers Committee and the Union Constitution Committee. The Provincial Constitution Committee was chaired by Sardar Patel, so statement 3 is false.
accepted.tq: Separate Union and Provincial committee responsibilities to detect the swapped chairman.
accepted.sec: Committees of the Assembly → chairman

accepted.s: The Advisory Committee on Fundamental Rights, Minorities, Tribal and Excluded Areas was chaired by:
accepted.x: Sardar Patel chaired the Advisory Committee on Fundamental Rights, Minorities, Tribal and Excluded Areas.
accepted.tq: Match the broad subject area of rights and minorities with its chairman.
accepted.sec: Committees of the Assembly → chairman

accepted.s:
Match List-I with List-II:
List-I (Sub-committee)
a. Fundamental Rights
b. Minorities
c. North-East Frontier Tribal Areas and Assam Excluded Areas
d. Excluded and Partially Excluded Areas other than Assam
List-II (Chairman)
i. A.V. Thakkar
ii. H.C. Mukherjee
iii. Gopinath Bardoloi
iv. J.B. Kripalani
accepted.x: J.B. Kripalani chaired the Fundamental Rights Sub-committee; H.C. Mukherjee the Minorities Sub-committee; Gopinath Bardoloi the North-East Frontier and Assam Sub-committee; and A.V. Thakkar the other Excluded Areas Sub-committee.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure Fundamental Rights pair and complete the specialised tribal-area matches.
accepted.sec: Committees of the Assembly → chairman

accepted.s: The Linguistic Provinces Commission, appointed on 17 June 1948, was chaired by:
accepted.x: The Linguistic Provinces Commission was chaired by S.K. Dar, a retired judge of the Allahabad High Court.
accepted.tq: Combine the committee's specialised subject with its date and chairman.
accepted.sec: Committees of the Assembly → chairman

accepted.s:
Which of the following statements regarding the Drafting Committee is correct?
1. It consisted of seven members.
2. It was chaired by Dr B.R. Ambedkar.
3. It sat for 141 days.
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: The Drafting Committee consisted of seven members, was chaired by Dr B.R. Ambedkar, and sat for 141 days.
accepted.tq: Combine composition, chairmanship and duration; all three statements are supported.
accepted.sec: Committees of the Assembly → chairman

accepted.s: Which one of the following was NOT a member of the seven-member Drafting Committee?
accepted.x: The Drafting Committee included Ambedkar, N. Gopalaswamy Ayyangar, Alladi Krishnaswamy Ayyar, K.M. Munshi, Saadullah, N. Madhava Rau and T.T. Krishnamachari. J.B. Kripalani chaired the Fundamental Rights Sub-committee and was not a member of the Drafting Committee.
accepted.tq: Separate a prominent sub-committee chairman from the members of the Drafting Committee.
accepted.sec: Committees of the Assembly → chairman
